display.purpose: Home headline and the h1 of every page head, set on the land.

headline.purpose: Section headings; a larger step (clamp 34 to 56px) for contact and founder titles.

title.purpose: Row and column headings inside sections.

body.purpose: Prose in secondary ink, about 34em to 640px wide.

lead.purpose: Lead paragraph of a page head.

figure.purpose: Quotable figures with tabular lining numerals; scales up to 6rem on the stage and 8rem on the factory page.

label.purpose: Uppercase legend-style heading, used as the heading itself.

label-small.purpose: Uppercase headings of short lists and contact items, and roles.

nav.purpose: Uppercase margin-bar links and language codes.

furniture.purpose: Uppercase foot margin, caption strips and scale steps.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Easing for map, stage, button and navigation transitions.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: clip-path circle(0%) to circle(140%) at the complex, 1.5s ease-out
motion.purpose: Home map entrance: the sheet develops outward from the complex.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: opacity 0 and translateY(14px) to rest, 0.8s ease-out, delays 0.15s / 0.45s / 0.6s

motion.name: beacon
motion.value: stroke-width 1 to 26, stroke-opacity 1 to 0, 1.1s ease-out, twice, after 1.1s
motion.purpose: Pulse on the complex plot after the map develops.

motion.name: scale-zoom
motion.value: transform scale(6) toward the complex, 1.2s ease-out
motion.purpose: Stage map between the region and site scales.

motion.name: plate-open
motion.value: clip-path circle(0%) to circle(75%), 0.9s ease-out, delay 0.5s
motion.purpose: Stage photograph opening from the plot.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-time fade-in of blocks entering the window.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Factory progress bar when it scrolls into view.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Content is visible by default; the stage switches without transitions.

narrative.overview:
Every page is one printed map sheet. The browser window is the deep green margin of the sheet; a 2px milk line frames the content inside it; the top is a margin bar with the name, the Solico Group endorsement, navigation and language. The home page opens on a drawn map of the Almaty and Zhetisu regions (Natural Earth linework, contours from open elevation tiles) with the complex in Konaev marked in yellow, a milk legend panel that is the table of key figures, an inset site photograph and a foot margin with conventional signs, credit and a measured scale bar.

Inner pages keep the sheet frame and the margin bar but read on milk grounds. Each opens with a green land page head set over the relief of the region, and green or deep bands break the milk sections. Components are map furniture: legend panels, hairline tables, state marks, scale bars, place labels. The density is that of a reference sheet: tables and rows with rules, few panels, no cards.

The system refuses the corporate hero photograph with a stats row and cards. Photographs appear as framed insets or plates with a caption strip, never as a full-bleed mood image.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet per page: deep margin, 2px milk frame line, square corners throughout.
Solico green land is the main ground; milk is linework, panels and reading ground.
One yellow, reserved for the complex.
State is a mark (solid, hatch, outline), never a hue.
Condensed capitals for labels and furniture; tabular numerals for figures.
Three equal languages (RU, KZ, EN); every face covers Kazakh letters.

rules.name: The Reserved Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow belongs to the complex: its plot, its name, its progress figure. The only other uses are focus rings on dark grounds and selection. It is never a button, a band, a link or a decoration.

rules.name: The Dark Water Rule
rules.body: Water is darker than land with a pale shoreline. Rivers and water names carry the only blue on the sheet.

rules.name: The Re-pointed Tokens Rule
rules.body: Green and deep bands do not get their own components. They re-point the ink, rule, link and placeholder tokens to milk values, so the same component reads on either ground.

rules.name: The Label-Is-The-Heading Rule
rules.body: A capital label is a heading in its own right, as on a legend. It is never stacked above another heading as a kicker or eyebrow. Page heads carry a title and an optional lead, nothing above them.

rules.name: The Quotable Figure Rule
rules.body: A figure is set in the narrow face with tabular numerals, with its unit beside it and its description, date and source directly under it.

rules.name: The Knock-Out Rule
rules.body: Type on the map or on the relief clears the linework behind it: map labels by a land-coloured stroke painted under the fill, headings by a land-coloured halo, and the home headline also by a land backing behind each line.

rules.name: The Lies-On-The-Map Rule
rules.body: A soft shadow appears only under a panel that lies on top of the drawn map. Anything on a plain ground is flat.

dos: Do frame every page as a sheet: deep margin, 2px milk frame line, sticky margin bar, deep footer.
Do open every inner page with the green page head over the relief, then read on milk grounds with green or deep bands between.
Do keep yellow for the complex: plot, Konaev label, the progress figure on green, the complex sign, plus focus rings on dark grounds and selection.
Do show state by mark: solid built, 45-degree hatch under construction, outline planned, with the word beside it.
Do set figures in PT Sans Narrow 700 with tabular numerals, with unit, description, date and source next to them.
Do clear linework behind any type placed on the map or the relief (stroke, halo or backing in the land colour).
Do draw structure with rules: 2px between grounds and above tables, 1px between rows.
Do check any new typeface for ә ғ қ ң ө ү һ ұ і before using it.
Do give every scroll-driven or animated element a static form for phones, no JavaScript and reduced motion.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading. A capital label is used only as the heading itself.
Don't use yellow for buttons, links, bands, icons or emphasis in prose.
Don't use hatching as decoration; it means under construction.
Don't signal state by colour alone.
Don't draw water pale or light blue; water is dark teal with a pale shoreline, and only rivers and water names are blue.
Don't round the corners of panels, buttons, frames or photographs.
Don't add shadows to anything that does not lie on the drawn map.
Don't use a full-bleed mood photograph as a hero, or cards with a stats row.
Don't place farms, suppliers or other points on the map that are not in the source data.
